reason: A is the better-grounded proposal because the cited work directly demonstrates deposition, microstructure, and improved PWR-relevant corrosion behavior of AlNbTiZr coatings on zirconium alloy, whereas B provides no evidence and implausibly assumes that oxygen will selectively generate a continuous alumina layer at the buried Cr–Zr interface. A still has a major gap: replacing Cr trivially eliminates Cr–Zr interdiffusion, and its cited evidence does not establish protection in 1000–1200°C steam, so that regime requires decisive validation.
